reviews.title: Dead Space
reviews.text: For some reason, when I play any song whether it’s normal or a sing-along, there is a dead space for the notes. On the lower half of my screen, the game simply doesn’t register my taps and it’s unbelievably frustrating. I can be tapping the screen and it just won’t register ANYTHING for a so,id 3-4 seconds, which when you’re playing a fast song is extremely damaging to your score. PLEASE figure out what’s causing this issue.

reviews.title: What happened to my song library!?
reviews.text: Another great app has been ruined by a pointless mandatory update. I loved Magic Piano as it was and played it whenever I was feeling stressed, so I played it often. Loved the look of it, the sounds, the songs and the scoring. Unfortunately 6.1.1 was released and when I tried to play my older version of it, I couldn't. Kept getting pulled to the update page. Having no choice other than deleting it, I updated. Man what a mess it is now! It looks visually as bad as Apple's IOS 7. The font type is very light and thin, there's way too much white background, and the song titles are nearly impossible to read. And a new design of light pastel colors too. So although the songs are still fun, the song title screen looks horrible and I don't play it as often. I certainly won't be purchasing any more titles for it. The point about updates is allowing choice. Some people might love it. But don't FORCE people into it. I hate it now. Please update and bring back the cool original look. Apple made a design mistake and so have you. I'm also having a lot of stress over the relentless ads that pop up. Some of them, the Disney one for instance does not go away. I have to literally close the app and re-open it. I don't recall the other versions being so advertising heavy. Please remove all these annoying commercials and let us simply play piano.

reviews.title: Composer is STILL broken
reviews.text: As mentioned in the title, composer has been broken for half a year at this point. This remains despite the reviews stating the same and sending multiple support tickets (where I am always reassured that the team know and are "working on it"). I'm aware that this app is maintained by a skeleton crew at this point but for the people that at any point actually cared about the creation aspect of the game this completely sours the experience. I'm saying this with a begrudging love, as someone who's been playing since 2014; fix your app.

reviews.title: Girl in underwear featured in ad!!!
reviews.text: My 10 year old boy has shown interest in learning piano. He was enjoying some familiar songs in this app when an ad popped up for Love Island which featured an animated girl (woman?) in bra and panties acting all coy and suggestive. It’s one of those ads that you can’t exit from and you have to wait through it all. I know the app doesn’t have complete say in every ad, but user beware, they do not screen their advertisers for age appropriate content. We deleted the app, but this incident prompted me to search Smule’s app and if this is their norm. Turns out that they also have chat features where strangers can connect and rate and comment on their songs. Other apps allow you to record yourself while singing and upload the video for review of public. This leads to access to your kids, their voice, and image, and also private conversations with strangers. Please be aware!!!!

reviews.title: Game Ruined
reviews.text: I had this app when I was a kid. I loved it. And it was accessible. Now it has been ruined with ads and pushes a $10/week or $20/month membership if you want the same experience I had for free as a kid. You can only earn 5 coins by watching an ad, which is outrageous. And every time you play a song an ad plays after and you don’t earn any coins for that. You only start off with 3 songs so there is no incentive to play unless you get a membership. I won’t be giving into that. It’s really a shame because I used to love this app.
